title: IPUMS microdata (USA/ACS, CPS and other collections)
agency: IPUMS, University of Minnesota (Census Bureau and BLS survey microdata)
questions: employment rates of immigrants by education
federal vs private sector wages by education
share of workers without health insurance by state
workers earning near the minimum wage
custom tabulations from ACS or CPS microdata

key_only: any extract through the API (the website builds the same extract with a free account and no key)

manual.how: Build the extract on the collection's website (usa.ipums.org, cps.ipums.org, ...) with a free account and no API key, following manual_download/ipums/INSTRUCTIONS.md (exact samples, variables, case selections, CSV format), or run download_ipums.sh / download_ipums.ps1 there with one command (the extract is built in; it asks for your key with hidden input); upload the .csv.gz data file and the .xml DDI codebook, then --ingest.

cache.why: Extracts are personal to the requesting account and governed by the IPUMS terms; data/ipums/ is reused within a run (reuse_existing) and never cached across analyses.

redistribution.why: IPUMS terms of use: users may not redistribute the data (extracts) without permission, except a subset to meet journal requirements, and must cite IPUMS with the dataset DOI. Ship the extract definition and the reproduce scripts; readers request the same extract under their own account. Aggregated estimates may be published.

notices: IPUMS microdata were used under the IPUMS terms of use; the extract itself is not redistributed. Its definition (extract_spec.json) and the reproduce scripts are included so the extract can be requested again.

retention.note: IPUMS deletes extract files about 72 hours after they are built. Keep data/ipums/extract_spec.json (the definition); it can be resubmitted at any time.

citation: {dataset} IPUMS, University of Minnesota, www.ipums.org. Cite the collection and its versioned DOI exactly as data/ipums/README.md gives them (taken from the extract's DDI codebook; for example IPUMS CPS, DOI 10.18128/D030.V13.0). Extract retrieved {retrieved_long}.

audit_hooks.why: Survey microdata estimates are sample-based: the report must state their standard errors or margins of error.
Every IPUMS estimate must be weighted; the methods must name the weight.
The extract definition is what a replication package ships instead of the microdata.

clarify: Which survey and years (samples)? ACS 1-year for states and small groups, ACS 5-year for very small areas, CPS ASEC for annual income, poverty and insurance (income refers to the previous year), CPS monthly for labor force and hourly earnings.
Universe: ages, civilians only (CPS CLASSWLY 25 includes active-duty military), household vs. group-quarters population, full-time full-year workers?
Weights and uncertainty: person or household weight, and standard errors by replicate weights (request REPWTP) or design-based (ACS STRATA/CLUSTER)?
Dollars: nominal or constant (which year, which deflator: CPI99 must be requested)?
